meta.purpose: Benchmark of grounded civic question answering. Each case states the expected intent, whether the system should answer or refuse, and which datasets must appear in the citations for an answer to count as grounded.
meta.grader: A response passes only if (a) the intent matches, (b) the answer/refuse decision matches, and (c) for answered cases every required dataset appears in the citations and at least one citation URL points at a real dataset.
meta.anti_hallucination: Cases marked must_refuse are the important ones: they are questions a general-purpose LLM answers confidently and wrongly. Passing means the system declines instead of inventing a number.

cases.q: Can I build a duplex at 1507 Bouldin Ave?
cases.why: Flagship. Must read the live designation and refuse to recite setbacks.

cases.q: Can I build a granny flat at 1507 Bouldin Ave?
cases.why: ADU guidance differs from duplex guidance.

cases.q: What can I build at 607 Bouldin Ave?
cases.why: Generic build question still needs a designation.

cases.q: Can I put a rental unit in the backyard at 1507 Bouldin Ave?
Is subdividing my lot at 1507 Bouldin Ave allowed?
cases.why: Subdivision phrasing using '-ing', which word-boundary matching must still catch.

cases.q: Can I build a duplex?
cases.why: No address. A confident yes/no here is the classic hallucination.

cases.q: What are the setbacks on my property?
cases.why: A setback question about an unspecified property: correct behaviour is to ask which property, not to quote a number.

cases.q: Is 1507 Bouldin Ave in a floodplain?
Is 1201 Nueces St at risk of flooding?
cases.why: Resolved to a corridor segment; the answer must disclose that the requested house number was not found.

cases.q: Will my house flood if I don't buy flood insurance at 1507 Bouldin Ave?
cases.why: Insurance framing still answerable from the zone.

cases.q: What does FEMA flood zone AE mean?
What does .2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD mean?
cases.why: The literal code string in the dataset.

What permits have been issued at 1507 Bouldin Ave?
What was built at 517 Bouldin Ave?

How many pothole requests were there in 2025?
What zoning categories does Austin have?

cases.q: Which streets get the most potholes?
cases.why: Street-level grouping is not in the dataset; must be honest about what it can group by.

Who represents me?
